race.comment: MIDNIGHT SPIRIT (1) may have suffered from the dreaded second-up syndrome last start but go on the solid win here when resuming. Can bounce back from the low draw. RUSSIAN RIPPER (10) is hard to knock having won three of his past four starts, the latest at this course and distance when getting home by just over a length. Gets the claim and only has to hold his form to be right in contention again. KOKATAHI (7) has placed in his two previous fresh attempts and also in his two starts over this distance. Should be ready to go off a couple of trials. TIZ WORTHY (4) has won third-up before so should be peaking and has the hoof on the till following back-to-back placings.
